Ordinary Americans are a blind spot for the elites in Washington.
 
When moms and dads lie down to sleep at night, they’re worried about inflation, crime, the border, and their kids’ education.

My Christmas wish for Louisianians is that they have hope when they get up every day and peace when they go to sleep every night.

Merry Christmas, Louisiana!

There’s a perception that Mr. Hunter Biden got special treatment from the DOJ. Some would argue he’s gotten special treatment his entire life.
 
What’s different now is that his dad is president of the United States and purports to stand for the rule of law. https://t.co/R8OgvxYJGH

No one knows the feeling of having their home or business destroyed by bad weather like Louisianians.

My bill would make sure Louisiana homeowners can sleep peacefully knowing that the NFIP won’t end in the middle of hurricane season.

https://t.co/19Pelnwf2B

AG Garland and U.S. Attorney David Weiss must clarify their statements about the Hunter Biden investigation, which aren’t adding up.

Americans deserve the truth, and we have a responsibility to exercise our oversight authority to uncover it.

https://t.co/0izODRQkq1

FEMA said that a lot of Louisianians would see their flood insurance premiums decrease.

Terrebonne Parish will see a 305% increase.

Lafourche Parish: Up 321%.

Plaquemines Parish: Up 540%.

FEMA lied. https://t.co/cf8VHUeSYZ

The Biden admin wants to limit Americans’ freedom to get affordable, short-term health insurance plans that fit their needs.

My Patients Choice Act would make sure bureaucrats can’t force Louisianians to pay more for insurance through Obamacare.

https://t.co/ddJzjtd3bC

A 2022 study found that roughly 10% of people who received transgender treatment de-transitioned.

If the 10% figure holds, gender activists will have wrongfully mutilated or sterilized more than 1,500 American children from 2017-2021 alone. https://t.co/Pj6ENx7s5s

The Biden admin is hellbent on virtue-signaling "equity" over the real needs of patients.

I’m demanding Pres. Biden's HHS remove DEI from the organ transplant process.

https://t.co/v50lWKA522

VP Harris’s record:
 
• Helped cause the worst inflation that America has had in 40 years.

• Compared Border Patrol agents to members of the KKK.

• Wanted to get rid of private health insurance. https://t.co/zSTy8UwGsl

VP Harris thinks you should turn all your money and freedom over to Washington.

That’s why she’s pushed for abolishing private health insurance for 180 MILLION Americans. https://t.co/BoWdp2PKSC

As Francine makes her way toward us, stay prepared by:

1. Following preparation directions from local officials.

2. Securing important documents like birth certificates, insurance information, etc. and moving them to an elevated location to avoid flood damage.

3. Anchoring outside property that is unsafe to keep indoors, such as gas grills or propane tanks.

4. Locating working batteries and flashlights.

When car insurance payments are up 54% and food prices are up 24% under Biden-Harris, you’re going to need a heck of a raise just to break even.

https://t.co/9ktiGLS0EV

I’m thankful we’ve delivered Louisianians additional disaster aid and protected their flood insurance so that the program doesn’t expire in the middle of hurricane season.

https://t.co/dj9j9E2SCz

Part of the problem with insurance is that the Biden-Harris admin revamped the program and raised premiums.
 
Now, too many Americans can’t afford the product. https://t.co/PtFcSUG3dm

This $5.2M will help New Orleans cover Hurricane Ida costs and support Plaquemines Parish’s seawater intrusion treatment efforts.

https://t.co/pVDITWt1MO

The National Flood Insurance Program is incredibly important for Louisiana.

I just tried to extend the NFIP program to protect our people, but my bill got blocked in the Senate. https://t.co/7QDB62MuA4

They/them are now was/were. ❤️

https://t.co/LKlfxzdXjF

Medicaid is supposed to be an investment in America’s health and well-being.

So why doesn’t it encourage more Americans to enter the workforce and improve their physical, mental, and financial health?

https://t.co/Hd8lVLoLcy
Requiring people on Medicaid who can work to get a job could save taxpayers more than $100 billion.

Human beings are happier AND healthier when they have a job.

Both taxpayers and Medicaid recipients would be better off if Medicaid had a work requirement for able-bodied adults.

The Corporation for Public Broadcasting should not be funneling Louisianians’ hard-earned tax dollars to outlets with one-sided coverage that clearly aim to promote a leftist political agenda.

The No Propaganda Act would make sure that Americans aren’t footing the bill for biased, government media.

https://t.co/drufDzp6G5

Government programs—like Medicaid—were not meant to be parking lots. They were meant to be bridges.

If you can work, you should work.
There’s a moral principle to Medicaid work requirements: If you can work, you should work.

Too many “journalists” today are taught to report on who, what, when, where, why, how—and their opinion.

But the government continues to fund one-sided coverage at NPR and PBS with your tax dollars. https://t.co/ZV4aXQjXxv
